panels.title: Онлайн
panels.description: Клиентов на нодах выбранных панелей прямо сейчас

targets.expr: sum(rwmon_node_online_users{panel_title=~"$panel"})

panels.title: Ноды
panels.description: Выключенные в панели ноды и ноды из exclude_nodes не считаются

targets.expr: sum(rwmon_node_connected{panel_title=~"$panel"})
count(rwmon_node_connected{panel_title=~"$panel"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Хосты
panels.description: Хосты с тегами MONITORING / MONITORING_LITE. Сбой — не проходит хотя бы одна проверка

targets.expr: count(count by (panel, host) (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel"}))

count(count by (panel, host) ((rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="xray"}) == 0) or (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="warp"}) == 0) or (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="psiphon"}) == 0))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Сеть нод сейчас
panels.description: Скорость сетевых интерфейсов всех серверов нод: RX — принято сервером, TX — отправлено

targets.expr: sum(rwmon_node_network_rx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * 8
sum(rwmon_node_network_tx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * 8

panels.title: Трафик клиентов
panels.description: Сколько клиенты скачали и отправили через все ноды за выбранный период

targets.expr: sum(increase(rwmon_node_inbound_upload_bytes{panel_title=~"$panel"}[$__range]) + increase(rwmon_node_inbound_download_bytes{panel_title=~"$panel"}[$__range]))
sum(rwmon_users{status="ACTIVE", panel_title=~"$panel"})
sum(rwmon_users_online{period="lastDay", panel_title=~"$panel"})

panels.title: Ноды
panels.description: CPU — load average за 5 минут на одно ядро. RX/TX — скорость сети сервера сейчас. Трафик и пик — за выбранный период. Чтобы посмотреть ноду подробно, выберите её вверху в «Нода».

targets.expr: sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_online_users{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_online_users{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((max_over_time(rwmon_node_online_users{panel_title=~"$panel"}[$__range])) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_network_rx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"} * 8) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_network_tx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"} * 8) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) (((rwmon_node_network_rx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"} + rwmon_node_network_tx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * 8) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((sum by (panel, node_uuid) (increase(rwmon_node_inbound_upload_bytes{panel_title=~"$panel"}[$__range]) + increase(rwmon_node_inbound_download_bytes{panel_title=~"$panel"}[$__range]))) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_cpu_load5{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_memory_used_ratio{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Сейчас не работает
panels.description: Хосты, которые не проходят проверку прямо сейчас, и сколько времени назад проверка проходила последний раз (в пределах суток)

targets.expr: (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (name) group_left (check) ((time() - max by (name) (max_over_time(timestamp(xray_proxy_status{check="xray"} == 1)[1d:1m]))) and on (name) (max by (name) (xray_proxy_status{check="xray"}) == 0))) or ((rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="xray"}) == 0) * 0 + 86400) or (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) ((time() - max by (name) (max_over_time(timestamp(xray_proxy_status{check="warp"} == 1)[1d:1m]))) and on (name) (max by (name) (xray_proxy_status{check="warp"}) == 0))) or ((rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="warp"}) == 0) * 0 + 86400) or (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) ((time() - max by (name) (max_over_time(timestamp(xray_proxy_status{check="psiphon"} == 1)[1d:1m]))) and on (name) (max by (name) (xray_proxy_status{check="psiphon"}) == 0))) or ((rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="psiphon"}) == 0) * 0 + 86400)

panels.title: Панели
panels.description: Трафик «из API» округлён панелью — для точного укажите metrics_url в config.toml

targets.expr: max by (panel_title) (rwmon_panel_up{panel_title=~"$panel"})
max by (panel_title, version) (rwmon_panel_info{panel_title=~"$panel"})
max by (panel_title) (rwmon_panel_traffic_exact{panel_title=~"$panel"})
sum by (panel_title) (rwmon_users_total{panel_title=~"$panel"})

panels.title: Клиенты онлайн
panels.description: По панелям, слоями: высота — сколько всего клиентов

targets.expr: sum by (panel_title) (rwmon_node_online_users{panel_title=~"$panel"})

panels.title: Сеть всех нод
panels.description: Вверх от нуля — принято серверами (RX), вниз пунктиром — отправлено (TX)

targets.expr: sum by (panel_title) (rwmon_node_network_rx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * 8
sum by (panel_title) (rwmon_node_network_tx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * 8

panels.title: Аутбаунды: $outbound
panels.description: Все ноды вместе. Вверх — ответы из аутбаунда, вниз — запросы в него. Если запросы есть, а ответов нет — аутбаунд сломан

targets.expr: sum by (tag) (rate(rwmon_node_outbound_download_bytes{tag=~"$outbound", panel_title=~"$panel"}[5m])) * 8
sum by (tag) (rate(rwmon_node_outbound_upload_bytes{tag=~"$outbound", panel_title=~"$panel"}[5m])) * 8

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_online_users{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_network_rx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"} * 8) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_network_tx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"} * 8) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((sum by (panel, node_uuid) (rate(rwmon_node_inbound_download_bytes{panel_title=~"$panel"}[5m])) * 8) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((sum by (panel, node_uuid) (rate(rwmon_node_inbound_upload_bytes{panel_title=~"$panel"}[5m])) * 8) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name, tag) ((rate(rwmon_node_outbound_download_bytes{tag=~"$outbound", panel_title=~"$panel"}[5m]) * 8) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name, tag) ((rate(rwmon_node_outbound_upload_bytes{tag=~"$outbound", panel_title=~"$panel"}[5m]) * 8) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_cpu_load5{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_memory_used_ratio{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node_name=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Подключение
panels.description: Строка — хост, колонка — панель. Одинаковые хосты разных панелей проверяются один раз

targets.expr: max by (panel_title, host) (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="xray"}))

panels.title: WARP
panels.description: Строка — хост, колонка — панель. Одинаковые хосты разных панелей проверяются один раз. Лёгкие (LTE) хосты здесь не проверяются

targets.expr: max by (panel_title, host) (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="warp"}))

panels.title: Psiphon
panels.description: Строка — хост, колонка — панель. Одинаковые хосты разных панелей проверяются один раз. Лёгкие (LTE) хосты здесь не проверяются

targets.expr: max by (panel_title, host) (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="psiphon"}))

panels.title: История сбоев
panels.description: Только хосты, у которых за выбранный период были сбои

targets.expr: (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="xray"})) and on (name) (min by (name) (min_over_time(xray_proxy_status{check="xray"}[$__range])) == 0) or (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="warp"})) and on (name) (min by (name) (min_over_time(xray_proxy_status{check="warp"}[$__range])) == 0) or (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="psiphon"})) and on (name) (min by (name) (min_over_time(xray_proxy_status{check="psiphon"}[$__range])) == 0)
